matrix.condition: same registry; `from` is a fresh tmp dir carrying an EMPTY `.pair/adoption/tech/way-of-working.md` (never nested under the repo or any real adoption tree); bindHosts({ from, registry }) run from BOTH the contract's own cwd (`.claude/workflows`) and a neutral cwd (`/`), by chdir'ing the test process around each call and restoring it in a `finally`
matrix.expected: resolveFrom resolves `from`'s own (empty) adoption file and NEVER falls back to process.cwd() in either case: same typed HostError reaches bindHosts, kind matches /^[a-z]+(-[a-z]+)*$/, message names github and never 'Github Projects' (the declared value this repo's own way-of-working carries, which a cwd leak would surface)
matrix.observed: base throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'hostsCode') from BOTH cwds — never the 'Github Projects' host-unsupported answer a cwd-fallback would produce; row is now cwd-independent by construction (an empty adoption file at `from` is always found first)
matrix.rationale: closes rejection r1-g4-w10b (resolveFrom-cwd-fallback-leak): the previous row let `from` have no adoption file at all, so resolveFrom's `(from && findAdoptionFile(from)) || findAdoptionFile(process.cwd())` fell back to whatever adoption file the ambient cwd exposed. Giving `from` an EMPTY way-of-working.md makes findAdoptionFile(from) succeed immediately, so the `||` branch is never reached — proven by asserting the SAME failure from two different chdir'd cwds, one of which (`.claude/workflows` inside the worktree) previously produced the declared-value answer.

matrix.condition: CLI `node <tmp>/scripts/host/index.mjs resolve --from <the same empty-adoption dir>` spawned via spawnSync with `cwd` explicitly set to that empty-adoption dir and `env` reduced to just PATH (hermetic — no ambient adoption-bearing cwd, no inherited env beyond PATH); run twice, once after chdir'ing the test process to `.claude/workflows` and once to `/`, to prove the spawn's own `cwd`/`env` options (not the parent's ambient cwd) are what make it hermetic
matrix.expected: exit non-zero from both parent cwds; stdout JSON carries no `kind` field — the kebab-case kind is read from `out.error` (matches /^[a-z]+(-[a-z]+)*$/), `out.message` names github and never 'Github Projects'
matrix.observed: base: out.error = "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'hostsCode')" (fails the kebab-kind regex on out.error, from both parent cwds) — the CLI never emits a `kind` field, confirming the row must read `out.error`
matrix.rationale: closes BOTH rejections on this row: (1) resolveFrom-cwd-fallback-leak — the CLI is spawned with `cwd` pinned to the empty-adoption dir (never inheriting the parent's ambient cwd) and a hermetic `env`, so it can never answer the declared 'Github Projects' case; (2) cli-error-field-read-as-kind — the assertion reads `out.error` (kebab kind), never a `out.kind` field the CLI does not emit.
